svg.aria-label: The StarTech 25U rack, top to bottom: the StarTech PDU (1U), the MikroTik CRS317 10G switch (1U), the UniFi US24 24-port 1G switch (1U), a shelf with the UniFi Cloud Gateway Ultra and a 4-bay Synology NAS, an empty space for a future NAS, the Dell R730 prxbox1 with a Quadro RTX 4000 8GB (2U), the Dell R730 prxbox2 with an RTX A4000 16GB (2U), and two UPS units (2U each).
